title: Un nuevo mundo
goal: Read how the Soviet Union's December 1991 dissolution ended the bipolar order and produced a "unipolar moment", and how Fukuyama's 1989 "end of history" essay framed the era before later debates challenged it.
grammar: orden posterior a la Guerra Fría

items: Explain what the bipolar system gave way to.
